sources.title: MobileViCLIP: An Efficient Video-Text Model for Mobile Devices
sources.snippet: This paper bridges this gap by introducing temporal structural reparameterization into an efficient image-text model and training it on a large-scale high-quality video-text dataset, resulting in an efficient video-text model that can run on mobile devices with strong zero-shot classification and retrieval capabilities, termed as MobileViCLIP.

sources.title: [2110.02178] MobileViT: Light-weight, General-purpose, and Mobile ...
sources.snippet: Towards this end, we introduce MobileViT, a light-weight and general-purpose vision transformer for mobile devices. MobileViT presents a different perspective for the global processing of information with transformers, i.e., transformers as convolutions.

sources.title: transformers/docs/source/en/model_doc/mobilevit.md at main ...
sources.snippet: MobileViT is a lightweight vision transformer for mobile devices that merges CNN's efficiency and inductive biases with transformers global context modeling. It treats transformers as convolutions, enabling global information processing without the heavy computational cost of standard ViTs.
